A1.justification: Both PDFs describe OccAny and contain 21 readable pages, including equations, Tables 1-13, Figures 1-13 and Appendices A-C. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that no material gaps limit comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original occupancy and segmentation evaluations, component ablations, cross-dataset generalization tests and supplementary trajectory and efficiency results in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix B, including the quantitative comparisons and ablations.

M1.justification: The reconstruction architecture, Segmentation Forcing, Novel-View Rendering, losses and inference procedure in Section 3 are identical. The OccAny+ adaptation in Appendix A.3 is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain the same five-dataset training mixture, SemanticKITTI and Occ3D-NuScenes occupancy evaluations, cross-dataset transfer scenarios and nuScenes ego-trajectory evaluation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including the main geometry baselines, in-domain occupancy methods and Appendix B's depth-completion, supervised-occupancy and trajectory comparators.

E3.justification: Input resolutions, validation splits, metrics, training schedules and TTVA settings are identical in Section 4 and Appendix A. Supplementary evaluation protocols in Appendix B also match.

E4.justification: The component and TTVA ablations, segmentation-feature study, depth-completion comparison, generalization analyses and qualitative examples are unchanged, including Table 6, Figure 6 and Appendices B-C.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for the experiments.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings match across Tables 1-13 and Figures 1-13. For example, OccAny retains 25.91% SemanticKITTI sequence IoU, 24.03% monocular IoU and 34.15% Occ3D-NuScenes surround-view IoU in Tables 1-3.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, model equations and loss formulations in Section 3 are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about unconstrained, zero-shot urban occupancy prediction and the contributions of Segmentation Forcing and Novel-View Rendering.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, result interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged, including the stated remaining gap to fully supervised in-domain performance.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times and code/project access information are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment supplies no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: All 89 cited works and the related-work positioning are unchanged. Reference differences reflect only line, column and page reflow.

P1.justification: v2 adds a Horizon Europe funding acknowledgment for grant 101214398 (ELLIOT) on page 9 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer acknowledgment shifts reference text across columns and pages 9-12. Figures, tables, captions and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The ELLIOT acknowledgment adds funding attribution, but the scientific content, empirical evidence, interpretations and reproducibility information remain identical. The accompanying version stamp and reference reflow produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
